name: fl-chain-mixed
description: One hop over the air, the next over Ethernet: n1 transmits to n2 by radio, n2 forwards to n3 over TCP/IP. The medium is a property of each LINK, not of the experiment.

radio.note: TX only: this node's whole job is to put the model on the air
RX only — and that is exactly why its downstream hop is tcp: it has nothing to transmit with

nodes.note: no radio at all: it is reached over Ethernet

links.note: up: B210 -> N210 over the air. down: n2 answers n1 over TCP, because the N210 never transmits.
the second hop is Ethernet in both directions
